<title level="1" right="Class Feature 17">[Quick Rage](/Classes.aspx?ID=2)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 82

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

You recover from your Rage quickly, and are soon ready to begin anew. After you spend a full turn without raging, you can Rage again without needing to wait 1 minute.
name: Quick Rage

<title level="1" right="Class Feature 11">[Mighty Rage](/Classes.aspx?ID=57)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 70

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

Your rage intensifies and lets you hit harder at the start of a fight. Your proficiency rank for your barbarian class DC increases to expert. In addition, when you use [Quick-Tempered](/Actions.aspx?ID=2803), the first Strike you make during your first turn deals additional damage equal to your [Rage](/Actions.aspx?ID=2802) damage.

<title level="1" right="Class Feature 17">[Revitalizing Rage](/Classes.aspx?ID=57)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 70

**Class** Barbarian
</column>

---

Your rage sustains you more frequently, leaving you ready to jump into battle anew. Instead of needing to wait 1 minute before you can gain [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) from [Rage](/Actions.aspx?ID=2802) again, you need only to spend at least one full turn not in a Rage.
name: Revitalizing Rage
